│ For the connected town (step 4), which experience do you want?
│ Today each room is a separate page: the square fades out and
│ the room loads. Rooms are 10x10 tiles; houses on the square are
│ 3 tiles wide.

❯ 1. Walk straight in (Recommended)
     One 3D world. Sam walks from the square through a door into
     the room with no page load; the camera follows, and the
     house's roof and front fade away while he is inside. Rooms
     keep their size, so they sit as wide buildings around a
     larger square, and you walk further between places. The
     largest build: several sessions.
  2. Smooth doorways
     Keep separate rooms, but the camera glides into the door and
     out again, and the real square shows outside each room's
     door, so it feels like one place. Much smaller: about one
     session.
  3. Town from above
     A zoomed-out view of the whole town with every building's
     inside visible from above (no roofs). Tap a building to zoom
     into it, and the room plays there. Medium build.
  4. Type something.
